exz: 裁縫師把我的褲子加長，因為對我來說太短了。

ex: Nobody believes him now, because everyone knows he is a {liar}.
exz: 現在再也沒有人相信他了，因為大家都知道他是個騙子。

ex: The {librarian} helped me find the books I needed for my history report.
exz: 圖書館員幫我找到歷史報告需要的書。

ex: You must be at least eighteen years old to get a driver's {license} in Taiwan.
exz: 在台灣至少要年滿十八歲才能考駕照。

ex: The {lifeguard} jumped into the pool and pulled the drowning child to safety.
exz: 救生員跳進泳池，把溺水的孩子救到安全的地方。

ex: Everyone has {limitations}, so do not feel bad if you cannot do everything perfectly.
exz: 每個人都有局限，所以如果不能把每件事都做得完美，也別難過。

ex: The hotel changes the bed {linen} every day, so the sheets are always clean.
exz: 這家飯店每天更換床單類，所以床單總是很乾淨。

ex: Before the party, she put on some red {lipstick} and looked at herself in the mirror.
exz: 派對前，她擦上紅色口紅，照了照鏡子。

ex: Stores in Taiwan are not allowed to sell beer, wine, or other {liquor} to people under eighteen.
exz: 台灣的商店不得販售啤酒、葡萄酒或其他酒類給未滿十八歲的人。

ex: The novel won several {literary} prizes and was later translated into twenty languages.
exz: 這本小說贏得數個文學獎，後來被翻譯成二十種語言。

ex: She majored in English {literature} because she loved reading novels and poems.
exz: 她主修英國文學，因為她熱愛閱讀小說和詩。

ex: They got a {loan} from the bank to buy a house and will pay it back over twenty years.
exz: 他們向銀行貸款買房，將在二十年內還清。

ex: The seafood restaurant is famous for its {lobster}, which is cooked with butter and garlic.
exz: 這家海鮮餐廳以奶油大蒜龍蝦聞名。

ex: There is no {logic} in his argument; his reasons do not support his conclusion at all.
exz: 他的論點毫無邏輯，他的理由完全無法支持他的結論。

ex: Since the ground is wet, the most {logical} explanation is that it rained last night.
exz: 既然地面是濕的，最合理的解釋是昨晚下過雨。

ex: After the big dinner, he had to {loosen} his belt because it felt too tight.
exz: 吃完大餐後，他得把皮帶鬆開，因為覺得太緊了。

ex: The food was cold and the service was slow; it was a really {lousy} meal.
exz: 食物是冷的，服務又慢，那真是一頓很糟的飯。

ex: The dog stayed {loyal} to its owner and waited at the station for him every day.
exz: 那隻狗對主人很忠誠，每天都在車站等他。

ex: The company gives gifts to old customers to thank them for their {loyalty}.
exz: 這家公司送禮物給老顧客，感謝他們的忠誠支持。

ex: The movie star lives in a {luxurious} house with a huge pool and ten bedrooms.
exz: 那位影星住在一棟有大泳池和十間臥室的豪宅。

ex: For many poor families, eating meat every day is a {luxury} they cannot afford.
exz: 對許多貧窮家庭來說，每天吃肉是負擔不起的奢侈。

ex: Farmers today use modern {machinery} instead of animals to plow their fields.
exz: 現今農夫用現代機械取代牲畜來犁田。

ex: A compass works because its needle is {magnetic} and always points north.
exz: 指南針能運作是因為它的指針有磁性，永遠指向北方。

ex: From the plane, we had a {magnificent} view of the snowy mountains below.
exz: 從飛機上，我們看到下方雪山壯麗的景色。

ex: The actress spent an hour putting on {makeup} before going on stage.
exz: 那位女演員上台前花了一小時化妝。

ex: If you do not know how to use the camera, read the {manual} that came with it.
exz: 如果你不會用這台相機，就讀一下隨附的使用說明書。

ex: This factory {manufactures} more than one thousand bicycles every day.
exz: 這間工廠每天製造一千多輛腳踏車。

ex: The car {manufacturer} called back all the cars because of a problem with the brakes.
exz: 這家汽車製造商因煞車問題召回所有車輛。

ex: Running a {marathon} is not easy; the race is about 42 kilometers long.
exz: 跑馬拉松並不容易，全程約42公里。

ex: The teacher wrote her comments in the {margin} of my essay, next to each mistake.
exz: 老師把評語寫在我作文的頁邊空白處，就在每個錯誤旁邊。

ex: Although he is only fifteen, he shows great {maturity} in the way he handles problems.
exz: 雖然他才十五歲，處理問題的方式卻非常成熟。

ex: The elevator can carry a {maximum} of ten people, so please wait for the next one.
exz: 這部電梯最多只能載十人，請等下一部。

ex: After a month of practice, there was a {measurable} improvement in her reading speed.
exz: 練習一個月後，她的閱讀速度有了明顯可測的進步。

ex: The nurse used a tape to {measure} the baby's height.
exz: 護士用捲尺量寶寶的身高。

ex: The government has taken strong {measures} to reduce air pollution in big cities.
exz: 政府已採取強力措施減少大城市的空氣污染。

ex: My car made a strange noise, so I took it to a {mechanic} to have it checked.
exz: 我的車發出怪聲，所以我把它送去給修車技師檢查。

ex: The flight was delayed for two hours because of a {mechanical} problem with the engine.
exz: 由於引擎機械故障，班機延誤了兩小時。

ex: Our trip to Kenya was so {memorable} that we still talk about it years later.
exz: 我們的肯亞之旅令人難忘，多年後我們仍常談起。

ex: A {memorial} was built in the park to honor the soldiers who died in the war.
exz: 公園裡建了一座紀念碑，紀念在戰爭中犧牲的士兵。

ex: Actors have to {memorize} all their lines before the first show.
exz: 演員必須在首演前背好所有台詞。

ex: In the past, {merchants} traveled by ship to sell silk and tea in other countries.
exz: 過去，商人搭船到其他國家販賣絲綢和茶葉。

ex: The king showed {mercy} and allowed the prisoner to go home to his family.
exz: 國王大發慈悲，讓那名囚犯回家與家人團聚。

ex: The tickets sold out in a {mere} ten minutes after they went on sale.
exz: 門票開賣後僅僅十分鐘就賣光了。

ex: Each plan has its {merits}, so we need to compare them carefully before choosing one.
exz: 每個方案都有其優點，所以選擇前要仔細比較。

ex: In the old days, kings sent {messengers} on horses to deliver important letters.
exz: 古時候，國王派信差騎馬遞送重要信件。

ex: His room is so {messy} that there are clothes and books all over the floor.
exz: 他的房間亂到衣服和書散落一地。

ex: Germs are too small to see with our eyes, but we can see them under a {microscope}.
exz: 細菌太小，肉眼看不到，但在顯微鏡下就能看見。

ex: Taiwan's winters are quite {mild}, so it seldom snows except in the high mountains.
exz: 台灣冬天相當溫和，除了高山外很少下雪。

ex: Farmers brought their wheat to the {mill}, where it was ground into flour.
exz: 農夫把小麥送到磨坊，在那裡磨成麵粉。

ex: After winning the lottery, the poor farmer became a {millionaire} overnight.
exz: 中了樂透後，那個窮農夫一夜之間成了百萬富翁。

ex: The {miners} worked deep underground, digging for coal all day.
exz: 礦工們在地底深處工作，整天挖煤。

ex: Milk contains calcium, a {mineral} that helps build strong bones and teeth.
exz: 牛奶含有鈣，這種礦物質有助於強健骨骼和牙齒。

ex: You need a {minimum} of sixty points to pass this test; anything lower is a fail.
exz: 這次考試至少要六十分才及格，低於這分數就是不及格。

ex: The {minister} of education announced new rules for high school exams.
exz: 教育部長宣布高中考試的新規定。

ex: The {Ministry} of Health warned people to wash their hands often during flu season.
exz: 衛生部提醒民眾在流感季節要常洗手。

ex: The naughty boys got into {mischief} by hiding their teacher's glasses.
exz: 那群頑皮的男孩惡作劇，把老師的眼鏡藏了起來。

ex: She felt {miserable} after losing her job and breaking her leg in the same week.
exz: 她在同一週丟了工作又摔斷腿，覺得很悲慘。

ex: He had the {misfortune} of losing both his parents when he was very young.
exz: 他很不幸，年紀很小時就失去了雙親。

ex: The advertisement {misled} customers into thinking the drink could help them lose weight.
exz: 那則廣告誤導消費者，讓他們以為這種飲料能幫助減重。

ex: Please do not {misunderstand} me; I did not mean to say your idea was bad.
exz: 請別誤會我，我不是說你的點子不好。

ex: Doctors suggest doing {moderate} exercise, such as walking, for thirty minutes a day.
exz: 醫生建議每天做三十分鐘適度的運動，例如散步。

ex: Although she won first prize, she was {modest} and said she was just lucky.
exz: 雖然她得了第一名，但她很謙虛，說自己只是運氣好。

ex: Despite his great success, his {modesty} made everyone like him even more.
exz: 儘管他非常成功，他的謙虛讓大家更喜歡他。

ex: Doctors {monitored} the patient's heart closely for 24 hours after the operation.
exz: 手術後，醫生密切監測病人的心臟24小時。

ex: A stone {monument} stands in the center of the town to remember the great leader.
exz: 鎮中心立著一座石碑紀念這位偉大的領袖。

ex: The apartment is close to the MRT station; {moreover}, the rent is quite low.
exz: 這間公寓離捷運站很近，而且房租相當低。

ex: The coach {motivated} the players by promising them a big party if they won.
exz: 教練承諾贏了就辦大型派對，以此激勵球員。

ex: Without clear goals, students often lose their {motivation} to study hard.
exz: 沒有明確的目標，學生常會失去用功的動力。

ex: Most of Taiwan is {mountainous}, so most people live on the flat land in the west.
exz: 台灣大部分地區多山，所以多數人住在西部的平地。

ex: After playing in the rain, the children came home with {muddy} shoes.
exz: 在雨中玩耍後，孩子們穿著沾滿泥巴的鞋子回家。

ex: The farmer used a {mule} to carry heavy bags of rice up the mountain path.
exz: 農夫用騾子把一袋袋沉重的米運上山路。

ex: The car accident caused {multiple} injuries; the driver broke his arm, leg, and nose.
exz: 這場車禍造成多處傷勢，駕駛的手臂、腿和鼻子都斷了。

ex: In the detective novel, the {murderer} turns out to be the quiet gardener.
exz: 在這本偵探小說中，兇手竟然是那個安靜的園丁。

ex: She {murmured} "Thank you" so softly that I could hardly hear her.
exz: 她輕聲說「謝謝」，小聲到我幾乎聽不見。

ex: A good friendship is built on {mutual} trust; both people must trust each other.
exz: 好的友誼建立在互信之上，雙方都必須信任彼此。

ex: No one knows who sent the {mysterious} letter; it had no name or address on it.
exz: 沒人知道是誰寄了這封神祕的信，上面沒有姓名也沒有地址。

ex: Only two students passed the exam, {namely} Tom and Lisa.
exz: 只有兩個學生通過考試，也就是湯姆和莉莎。

ex: The team has players of different {nationalities}, including Japanese, Korean, and French.
exz: 這支隊伍有不同國籍的球員，包括日本、韓國和法國籍。

ex: The charity gives free food and clothes to {needy} families in the area.
exz: 這個慈善團體免費提供食物和衣服給當地的貧困家庭。

ex: He was so busy with work that he {neglected} his family and seldom came home for dinner.
exz: 他工作太忙而疏忽了家人，很少回家吃晚餐。

ex: The workers {negotiated} with the company for higher pay and shorter working hours.
exz: 工人與公司協商，要求更高的薪資和更短的工時。

ex: The weather was terrible; {nevertheless}, thousands of fans came to the concert.
exz: 天氣很糟，儘管如此，仍有數千名歌迷來參加演唱會。

ex: After watching the horror movie, the little girl had a {nightmare} and woke up crying.
exz: 看完恐怖片後，小女孩做了惡夢，哭著醒來。

ex: Giving up his own seat on the boat to save a child was a {noble} act.
exz: 讓出船上自己的位子去救一個孩子，是高尚的行為。

ex: The idea that the earth is flat is complete {nonsense}.
exz: 地球是平的這種想法完全是胡說八道。

ex: In the past, people wrote letters by hand, but {nowadays} most people send emails.
exz: 過去人們手寫信件，但現今大多數人寄電子郵件。

ex: After the accident in Japan, many people began to worry about the safety of {nuclear} power plants.
exz: 日本發生事故後，許多人開始擔心核電廠的安全。

ex: The singer has won {numerous} awards, more than any other artist in Asia.
exz: 這位歌手贏得無數獎項，比亞洲任何藝人都多。

ex: Parents can leave their young children in the {nursery} while they shop in the mall.
exz: 家長在商場購物時，可以把幼兒託在托兒所。

ex: Fresh fruit and vegetables are {nutritious} and good for your health.
exz: 新鮮蔬果很有營養，對健康有益。

ex: The dog went to a training school to learn {obedience}, such as sitting when told.
exz: 那隻狗去訓練學校學習服從，例如聽口令坐下。

ex: The {obedient} child always did what his parents asked without complaining.
exz: 那個聽話的孩子總是照父母的要求做，從不抱怨。

ex: If there are no {objections}, we will start the meeting with the first topic.
exz: 如果沒有異議，我們就從第一個議題開始開會。

ex: A good reporter should be {objective} and present the facts without personal opinions.
exz: 好的記者應保持客觀，呈現事實而不帶個人意見。

ex: After weeks of careful {observation}, the scientist learned how the birds built their nests.
exz: 經過數週仔細觀察，科學家了解了這些鳥如何築巢。

ex: Poor English was the greatest {obstacle} he faced when he moved to London.
exz: 英文不好是他搬到倫敦時面對的最大障礙。

ex: You need to {obtain} permission from your parents before joining the school trip.
exz: 參加校外教學前，你需要取得父母的同意。

ex: The weather will be mostly sunny tomorrow, with {occasional} showers in the afternoon.
exz: 明天大致晴朗，下午偶有陣雨。

ex: On the form, please write your name, age, and {occupation}, such as teacher or nurse.
exz: 請在表格上填寫姓名、年齡和職業，例如老師或護理師。

ex: All the seats on the bus were {occupied}, so I had to stand all the way.
exz: 公車上所有座位都有人坐，所以我只好一路站著。

ex: I'm sorry if my joke {offended} you; I did not mean to hurt your feelings.
exz: 如果我的玩笑冒犯了你，我很抱歉，我不是有意傷你的心。

ex: Driving after drinking is a serious {offense} and can lead to a heavy fine.
exz: 酒後駕車是嚴重的違法行為，可能被處以重罰。

ex: Some of his jokes were so {offensive} that several people walked out of the show.
exz: 他有些笑話太冒犯人，好幾個觀眾直接離場。

ex: We went to the theater to see an Italian {opera}, in which all the actors sang their lines.
exz: 我們去劇院看一齣義大利歌劇，所有演員都用唱的唸台詞。

ex: Many residents {oppose} the plan to build a factory near the school.
exz: 許多居民反對在學校附近蓋工廠的計畫。

ex: Since the last bus had left, taking a taxi was our only {option}.
exz: 既然末班公車已經開走了，搭計程車是我們唯一的選擇。

ex: It takes the earth one year to complete its {orbit} around the sun.
exz: 地球繞太陽運行一圈需要一年。

ex: The {orchestra} has more than eighty musicians who play the violin, flute, drums, and other instruments.
exz: 這個管弦樂團有八十多位樂手演奏小提琴、長笛、鼓和其他樂器。

ex: During the {orientation} for new students, we were shown around the campus.
exz: 新生訓練時，我們被帶著參觀校園。

ex: After both his parents died in the accident, the boy became an {orphan} and lived with his aunt.
exz: 父母雙亡於那場意外後，男孩成了孤兒，和阿姨一起住。

ex: Take an umbrella with you; {otherwise}, you will get wet in the rain.
exz: 帶把傘吧，否則你會被雨淋濕。

ex: Nobody can predict the {outcome} of the election until all the votes are counted.
exz: 在所有選票計算完之前，沒人能預測選舉的結果。

ex: She received a prize for her {outstanding} performance in the science contest.
exz: 她因在科學競賽中的傑出表現而獲獎。

ex: An egg has an {oval} shape; it is not perfectly round.
exz: 雞蛋是橢圓形的，不是正圓形。

ex: It was freezing outside, so he put on a thick {overcoat} before leaving the house.
exz: 外面冷得要命，所以他出門前穿上一件厚大衣。

ex: With the help of her friends, she was able to {overcome} her fear of speaking in public.
exz: 在朋友的幫助下，她得以克服對公開演講的恐懼。

ex: The editor {overlooked} a few spelling mistakes, so they appeared in the printed magazine.
exz: 編輯漏看了幾個拼字錯誤，所以印出的雜誌上出現了這些錯誤。

ex: The singer became famous {overnight} after her video was watched by millions of people.
exz: 她的影片被數百萬人觀看後，這位歌手一夜成名。

ex: The people rose up and {overthrew} the cruel king who had ruled them for thirty years.
exz: 人民起義推翻了統治他們三十年的殘暴國王。

ex: Plants give off {oxygen}, which humans and animals need in order to breathe.
exz: 植物會釋放氧氣，那是人和動物呼吸所需的。

ex: Some students learn quickly and others slowly, so let each child learn at his own {pace}.
exz: 有些學生學得快，有些學得慢，所以讓每個孩子照自己的步調學習。

ex: A {panel} of five judges chose the winner of the singing contest.
exz: 一個由五位評審組成的小組選出歌唱比賽的冠軍。

ex: The pilot jumped out of the plane and opened his {parachute} to land safely.
exz: 飛行員跳出飛機，打開降落傘安全著陸。

ex: Each {paragraph} in your essay should begin with a clear topic sentence.
exz: 作文中的每個段落都應以清楚的主題句開頭。

ex: The plan was only a {partial} success; we finished half the work on time.
exz: 這計畫只算部分成功，我們只準時完成一半的工作。

ex: Thanks to the active {participation} of the students, the school fair raised a lot of money.
exz: 多虧學生積極參與，學校園遊會募到了很多錢。

ex: The two friends formed a business {partnership} and opened a coffee shop together.
exz: 這兩個朋友合夥做生意，一起開了一家咖啡店。

ex: Instead of being {passive} in class, you should ask questions and share your ideas.
exz: 上課時與其被動，你應該提問並分享想法。

ex: Spaghetti is the most popular kind of {pasta} served in Italian restaurants.
exz: 義大利直麵是義式餐廳最受歡迎的麵食。

ex: The cat licked its {paw} and then used it to wash its face.
exz: 那隻貓舔了舔腳掌，再用它洗臉。

ex: There was a {peculiar} smell in the kitchen, and nobody knew where it came from.
exz: 廚房裡有股怪味，沒人知道是從哪裡來的。

ex: The curious child {peeped} through the small hole in the door to see what was inside the room.
exz: 好奇的孩子從門上的小洞偷看房間裡有什麼。

ex: Teenagers often feel pressure from their {peers} to dress and act like everyone else.
exz: 青少年常感受到同儕壓力，要穿著舉止和大家一樣。

ex: The {penalty} for parking here is a fine of 600 dollars.
exz: 在這裡停車的處罰是罰款六百元。

ex: About seventy {percent} of the earth's surface is covered by water.
exz: 地球表面約百分之七十被水覆蓋。

ex: A high {percentage} of students in our class wear glasses—almost eight out of ten.
